run_gtest_output_test: run the googletest output test suite to verify test framework text output matches golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a golden output file by running gtest_output_test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time information
remove_locations: remove file location info from googletest output replacing paths with filename and line number placeholders
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from googletest program output using regex substitution
